0022600029.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2, 2nd in the Northwest, 5th in the West, on a two-game win streak) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-2, 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, 4th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) in their 9th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. Out for the Thunder are Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Grizzlies are without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness) and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee issue and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 117-116 win in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
